tos_google_login_body: Registration is exclusively handled via Google OAuth. We only process identity data (name, email) for authentication purposes.
tos_account_security_body: You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and devices used for transactions.
tos_liability_quote: TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, DUKAPP SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES ARISING FROM DONATIONS.
tos_liability_body: We do not warrant that the service will be uninterrupted. Third-party payment providers are responsible for processing credit card transactions.
pp_google_data_body:
We only access your name, email address, and profile picture from Google for authentication purposes. We do not sell this data to third parties.
DukApp's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
pp_payment_data_body: DukApp does not see or store your credit card details. All transactions are processed by a secure, third-party payment partner.
pp_usage_body: Your data is used exclusively to provide the service, confirm transactions, and maintain account security.
pp_rights_body: You have the right to request the deletion or modification of your data through the app settings or via email.
